name: app-emerald-portrait-photo-app-held-beside-face
title: Emerald Photo App Held Beside a Face
whatItIs: A cover where a woman in profile holds a phone with a dark teal photo-editing app next to her face, on an emerald gradient with giant ghost 'FaceNova' lettering and a hex logo.
whatItMeans: Putting the phone beside a real face tells the product story instantly (face editing). Deep emerald feels premium.
techniques: Person in profile pairing subject with product
Ghost brand name cropped behind the figure
Deep green gradient with a light glow behind the head
Ring and hand detail for realism

vocabulary.definition: A side view of a face used as a compositional anchor.
Oversized low-contrast brand text behind the subject.
Showing an app next to the thing it acts on.
